units: Ber. 3ᵇ (expl. נֶשֶׁף) נ׳ ליליא וכ׳ the night blows (expires), and the day comes in; the day blows, and night sets in (Rashi: retires), v. נֶשֶׁף, נִשְׁפָּא.

senses.gloss: to be covered with breath, to become dim.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 50b:20">Men. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>אִינַּשְּׁפָה לה</he> (Ar. <he>איג׳</he>, Var. <he>אינ׳</he>; some ed. Ar. <he>אינשבא</he>) the bread loses its glistening surface (when it gets stale).
